newsitem.title: PERU: Peru TV shows image of hostages inside residence.
newsitem.headline: Peru TV shows image of hostages inside residence.

text.p: A Peruvian television station on Saturday showed a photograph of hostages inside the Japanese ambassador's residence held by Marxist rebels.
The Channel 5 photograph showed at least seven men, some sitting on chairs or the floor and some standing, dressed in elegant shirts and pants and looking relaxed.
The television station did not say when the still was taken nor how it was obtained.
None of the hostages in the photograph were immediatley identified.

Channel 5 said it would present more pictures later on Saturday including an image of Peruvian Foreign Minister Francisco Tudela, held by the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) rebels along with 340 hostages since late Tuesday.
